brand.metaTitle: Greenweave — Clothes that heal the Earth
footer.description: Clothes grown from organic and recycled fibres, cut in small batches with respect for people and the planet.

home.marqueeItems: 100% organic cotton, recycled ocean plastic, fair trade studios, plastic-free packaging
home.pillarsTitle: Better for you, better for Earth
home.pillar1Text: GOTS-certified cotton, hemp and bamboo — no pesticides, no GMOs.
home.pillar2Text: Up to 40% less water and zero toxic runoff into rivers.
home.pillar3Text: Recycled bottles and regenerated fabrics in every drop.
home.pillar4Text: Fair-trade wages in transparent, safe workplaces.
home.testimonial1Text: The leggings survived 20+ classes and still look new. Knowing they're made from ocean plastic makes them my favourite.
home.testimonial2Text: Softest organic tees I've ever worn, and they arrived in beautiful paper packaging. Ethics aside, the feel is unreal.
home.testimonial3Text: Finally a brand that cares. I love scanning the QR to trace where every piece came from. This is the future.
home.newsletterText: Drops, giveaways and a small seeding of good news. No spam, just seeds.
about.title: Made for today, better for tomorrow.
about.text: Greenweave is a 2026 startup formed by the youth for the youth. New clothes made with fabrics made from clothes you may have once worn"
about.badge: what was, what is, what will be- we use the old and make the new, you give our creations wings🦋
about.promise1Text: GOTS-certified organic cotton, European flax hemp and bamboo viscose. No pesticides, no GMOs, no shortcuts.
about.promise2Text: Low-water dyeing and natural indigo save up to 40% water per garment, with zero toxic runoff.
about.promise3Text: Every recycled-polyester piece turns discarded bottles and ocean plastic into fabric you'll love wearing.
about.promise4Text: We cut in small batches and tag every garment so you can trace it back to the mill and the hands that made it.
about.promise5Text: More than just false promises, we reuse leftover cloth while mantaining quality.
about.promise6Text: Fair-trade wages, safe studios, and long-term partnerships with our makers.

about.ctaText: Explore pieces that feel as good as they do good.
